title: propertyConfig
description: Documents and validates window.propertyConfig, as set in site-data.js. This schema describes the config contract as the template ACTUALLY works today (verified against script.js/booking-logic.js/scripts/sync-seo.js), not a hypothetical future shape. It is a development/quality tool only — it is never loaded at runtime and has no effect on the live site. Validate with: node scripts/validate-config.js (see that file for how).

name.description: Property name. Rendered unconditionally in nav logo and footer (data-property-name).

heroDetails.description: e.g. "Private Pool · 5 Bedrooms · Up to 15 Guests".

heroImage.description: Relative path to the hero image, e.g. "assets/images/hero.webp". Note: index.html also has a hardcoded <link rel=preload> pointing at the hero image, kept in sync manually (see PROPERTY-CHECKLIST.md section 3) — this schema cannot check that they match.

heroImageAlt.description: Optional. If omitted, the alt text hardcoded in index.html is left untouched (see script.js renderStaticContent).

aboutImage.description: Optional. Both src and alt are independently optional — script.js only overwrites the hardcoded HTML fallback for whichever of the two is actually present.

locationBody2.description: Dead field, kept intentionally (Fase 2.4): read by script.js as [data-property-location-body-2], but no element in index.html has that attribute, so it is never rendered. Contains real, filled-in travel-distance content, not a placeholder — not removed from the schema so it stays a documented, valid field rather than an undocumented one. See full-audit.md.

mapEmbedUrl.description: Keyless Google Maps embed src for the <iframe>.

email.description: Optional. Empty string means the footer falls back to "Contact via Facebook" + contactUrl (see script.js renderStaticContent).

contactUrl.description: Used both as the email-fallback contact link and for the two data-property-contact-link buttons.

photosUrl.description: Dead field, kept intentionally (Fase 2.4): read by script.js as [data-property-photos-link], but no element in index.html has that attribute, so it is never rendered. Same status as locationBody2 — real content (a Google photosphere link), not a placeholder.

seo.description: Optional in full. title/description are also applied at runtime by applySeoMeta(). ogImage/siteUrl/twitterHandle/googleSiteVerification are only used by `node scripts/sync-seo.js` to bake static tags into index.html for bots that don't execute JavaScript — they have no runtime effect.

ogImage.description: Relative or absolute path. Falls back to heroImage when empty.

siteUrl.description: e.g. "https://celinepoolvilla.com". Leave "" to skip canonical/absolute og:image/twitter:image URLs.

googleSiteVerification.description: Domain-specific Search Console token. A fresh one is required per domain when this template is reused.

analytics.description: Optional in full. Loaded dynamically by initAnalytics() in script.js. Leave either field "" to disable that tracker.

localizedTextOptional.description: Same {en, th} shape as localizedText, but both keys are optional and an empty string is allowed — used where site-data.js itself intentionally leaves a language blank (e.g. seo.title.th) and relies on a documented runtime fallback.

isoDate.description: "YYYY-MM-DD". Note: the schema can only check the shape — expandBlockedDates() in booking-logic.js additionally rejects calendar-invalid dates like "2026-02-30" at runtime; that check is not expressible as a JSON Schema pattern.

iconKey.description: Must match a key in the icons map in iconSvg() (script.js). An unrecognized icon key does not error — it silently renders the "pin" icon — so this enum exists to catch that class of silent bug.

span.description: Matches the .gallery-item.is-* grid classes in style.css. Optional — falls back to "" (default grid cell) if omitted.

width.description: Actual pixel width of the file — used as the width attribute for CLS prevention, must match the real file (see PROPERTY-CHECKLIST.md section 3).

ga4Id.description: Mirrors GA4_ID_PATTERN in script.js (/^G-[A-Z0-9]{4,}$/i). Empty string disables GA4. An invalid non-empty value is skipped at runtime with a console.warn rather than sent as-is — this schema catches it earlier.

clarityId.description: Mirrors CLARITY_ID_PATTERN in script.js. Empty string disables Clarity.

blockedDateEntry.description: Mirrors expandBlockedDates() in booking-logic.js: either a single ISO date string, or an inclusive { from, to } range.

numberLocales.description: Keyed by site language (see translations.js). additionalProperties is intentionally allowed here (unlike most other objects in this schema) so a future third language only needs a new key, not a schema change. formatMoney() in booking-logic.js falls back to "en-US" if a language's entry is missing or invalid, so no key here is required.

bookingIntegrationEntry.description: Not read by any code yet — a Phase 3 placeholder (see getBlockedDates() in script.js). If you include this entry at all, it should have this exact shape.

booking.description: Optional in full — initBooking() (script.js) hides the entire booking section and its nav link when booking.enabled is falsy or the block is missing, so a property without online booking simply omits this. Nothing inside is required on its own: calculateBookingPrice() and the parseX() helpers in booking-logic.js all fall back gracefully when individual fields are missing.

formspreeEndpoint.description: Each property MUST have its own Formspree endpoint — reusing another property's sends its booking requests to the wrong owner's inbox with no visible error. Leave "" (with enabled: false, or omit booking entirely) rather than reuse another property's value.

currency.description: Free-form display string, e.g. "THB". Concatenated as-is after the formatted amount — not validated against ISO 4217 by the runtime, so not constrained here either.

pricePerNight.description: 0 hides all price display; the calendar still works.

minimumStay.description: parseMinimumStay() coerces 0, negative or non-numeric values to 1 silently (a known, documented inconsistency vs. maximumStay/bookingHorizonMonths — see full-audit.md section 4) — this schema treats 0 as invalid rather than encoding that silent coercion.

bookingHorizonMonths.description: null = no horizon (not recommended — see script.js).

integrations.description: Phase 3 placeholders, not read by any code yet (see getBlockedDates() in script.js). additionalProperties allowed so a future channel (e.g. "agoda") doesn't require a schema change.

contact.description: Where booking requests should notionally go. Only contact.email is currently read by code (CC'd into the Formspree submission) — phone/line are documented, bevisst-forberedt placeholders for a future real integration, not dead/forgotten fields.
